subject.title: feat(macos): native-feel dashboard hosting — instant reopen, preload, frame autosave, ⌘N/⌘K, route memory

question: Should background dashboard preload and persisted route restoration become unconditional defaults for existing macOS users?
rationale: These behaviors change startup work, navigation state, failure timing, and credential-sensitive reload behavior; tests cannot establish whether that default product policy is intended.

options.title: Approve the defaults
options.body: Keep preload and route persistence as defaults after rebasing, fixing the blockers, and supplying signed-app upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Land instant reopen, frame autosave, shortcuts, context-menu cleanup, and theming while deferring background preload and route persistence.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause the PR until the macOS product owner defines the desired preload and navigation-memory policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the defaults
recommendation.body: Keep preload and route persistence as defaults after rebasing, fixing the blockers, and supplying signed-app upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available product owner for the hybrid macOS shell direction and the default behavior proposed by this branch.
